subject: Joint webinar + co-demo with FlowOps: pilot plan and logistics

Subject: Re: Potential joint demo + webinar?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro — this sounds promising. FlowOps is always looking for lightweight partner co-demos that show a real developer workflow. A quick ask from our side: could you sketch a 20‑minute joint demo (FlowOps + Redwood) focused on a real integration (CI pipeline + inference caching)? If we keep it to 30–40 minutes total with 10–15 minutes for Q&A, our SDRs will promote it through our regional newsletters.

I took a stab at a rough agenda and attached it here — happy to iterate.

Proposed: 30 min demo (15min Redwood + 10min FlowOps + 5min joint live ask) + 15min Q&A / follow-ups.

Couple of logistics we care about:
- Preferred platform (Zoom vs Hopin). We usually run on Zoom webinars.
- Co-branded landing page + form (we can host).
- Recording and gated asset (how do you want to handle lead sharing / MQL passback?).

If this is useful, let's lock a date in April — midweek mornings (PDT) work best for our engineering audience.

Best,
Maya
Maya Reddy
Head of Partnerships | FlowOps

I attached a partner comms template for the registration page / email motion. Can we set a tentative date: Wednesday, 17 April 2028 at 10:00 AM PDT? If that works I’ll put calendar holds and draft a joint landing page.

1) Confirm platform (Zoom webinar) — Maya
